source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB SDR enumeration; high-level sdr list cannot replace reservation/next-ID/raw-record proof.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A/0x23 with zero reservation, one LS-byte record placeholder, offset0/countFF; increments IDs until returned FF FF; log clear.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Provides inventory view but hides exact ID width, reservation and record bytes.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE using reservation-aware next-record traversal and bounded parsing.
historical_reviews.history: Reserve is coordination only; Add/Delete/Clear are separate mutations.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Reject numeric ID increment and follow returned two-byte next ID.

original_test_intent: Enumerate and decode the complete SDR repository through bounded read-only record traversal.
original_method: Use Storage 0x0A/0x23 with reservation, two-byte record ID, offset/count and returned next-record ID.
manual_activity: Owner approves target SDR/OEM schemas, traversal budget and metadata-redaction policy once.
agent_execution_scope: Read ID0 then returned next IDs
Stop at FFFF or bounded error

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: sdr list -v is only a cross-check because it normalizes records and hides reservation and traversal behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw 0x0A/0x23 with two-byte IDs and returned-next-ID traversal; compare high-level output independently.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source command/Script/timing preserved; unsafe numeric increment is explicitly not executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a bounded raw record inventory using returned links, per-record validation and repository metadata snapshot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects ID width/traversal and adds reservation/cycle guards.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Rendered sensor values do not prove raw SDR record completeness or linkage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent mutation or cyclic/malformed records can invalidate enumeration.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish inventory is equivalent only for decoded sensor coverage, not raw IPMI traversal; skipped raw coverage remains explicit.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title/command align, but source uses an incomplete one-byte ID and unsafe numeric increment rather than returned linkage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Correct read semantics are identifiable; schema/budget are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Replaces guessed ID walking with reservation-aware linked traversal and complete raw-record evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDR record IDs are opaque two-byte identifiers, not guaranteed consecutive integers. Completeness must follow each response's next-record ID while detecting cycles, cancellation and malformed lengths; otherwise a syntactically successful list can silently skip or duplicate records.
